threat_event: Ransomware that starts in business IT spreads through the BCC or South Florida site firewalls into the SCADA network and encrypts SCADA servers and HMIs at the OCC and BCC
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT DMZ only at the OCC; BCC and South Florida HMIs reach the OCC over the corporate SD-WAN with broad rules; unsupported OS at the BCC; no OT monitoring outside the Panhandle
existing_controls: OT DMZ at the OCC; MFA; EDR with 24x7 MDR on IT; immutable cloud backups
treatment_plan: Extend the OT DMZ pattern to the BCC and South Florida office; remove SD-WAN routes from corporate subnets to HMIs; interim rule reduction by 2026-11-30
exposure_estimate_usd: $2.5M-$6M (72-hour multi-area outage, response, restart; insurance limit $15M)

threat_event: Exfiltration of royalty owner and employee personal information for extortion before or during ransomware
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Full owner deck copy with Social Security numbers in the data platform readable by all engineers; owner tax files sent by email; egress alerting only on the data platform
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03; SYS-04 data platform; SYS-07; SYS-10; BP-09
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)-(5); breach laws of each state where affected individuals reside
existing_controls: MFA; EDR and MDR; data platform access logging
treatment_plan: Remove Social Security numbers from the data platform copy; secure transfer for owner tax files; egress alerting on file services
exposure_estimate_usd: $2M-$5M (about 14,000 owners and 850 employees notified; counsel, call center, credit monitoring)

threat_event: SCADA server images and controller programs are destroyed with production systems, so SCADA cannot be rebuilt within the 12-hour RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Offline images stored at the BCC, which the corporate network can reach; image restore never tested; controller repository covers about 60% of controllers
existing_controls: Weekly offline SCADA images; immutable cloud backups
treatment_plan: Second offline image set in a safe at headquarters with no network path; quarterly test restore on a spare server; complete the controller repository
exposure_estimate_usd: $1M-$3M (days of manual operations and shut-ins beyond the BIA MTD)

threat_event: Attacker uses the flow computer vendor's support modem, outside the jump host, to reach the Panhandle Central Facility network and change LACT or pump station settings
threat_source: Cybercriminal or hacktivist using vendor credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor modem bypasses the jump host; shared vendor password; no logging of sessions
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-12; SYS-02 (LACT flow computers; pump station PLC); BP-04; BP-05
existing_controls: Hardwired high-pressure shutdowns; modem powered on only when the vendor calls (by practice, not enforced)
treatment_plan: Disconnect the modem; vendor support only through the jump host with a named account, MFA, and recording

threat_event: Exploit of a known vulnerability in the unsupported operating system on the BCC standby server and South Florida HMIs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OS past end of vendor support; compensating controls only partly applied
existing_controls: Primary OCC upgraded 2025; EDR not supported on these hosts
treatment_plan: Upgrade with the SCADA vendor's qualified version; until then, application allowlisting and no corporate access
exposure_estimate_usd: $500K-$2M (loss of the BCC as a recovery site; spread toward the OCC)

threat_event: Manipulated setpoints or valve commands at the gathering pump station cause an overpressure event or hide a release near the drinking water unusually sensitive area
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pump station reachable from OCC HMIs and engineering workstations; setpoint changes not under change control; leak analytics advisory only
existing_controls: Hardwired high-pressure shutdown switches independent of SCADA; line riders; OT sensor at the Central Facility
treatment_plan: Setpoint changes through the CAB with a second reviewer; alarm on any setpoint write; monthly comparison with the MOP record
exposure_estimate_usd: $1M-$10M (release cleanup near a drinking water area, shut-in, enforcement)

threat_event: Wrong or altered flow computer configuration misstates LACT volumes delivered for shippers and the company
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flow computer configuration changes not logged centrally; no second-person review; one portal administrator
existing_controls: Monthly meter proving; ticket hashing in the measurement data service
treatment_plan: Capture flow computer configuration and audit logs nightly; second-person review for configuration changes; second portal administrator

threat_event: Unapproved PLC or RTU logic change in South Florida or Alabama alters an injection pressure limit or a shutdown setting
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No change control or second reviewer for controller changes outside the CAB; repository covers about 60% of controllers
existing_controls: CAB for SCADA servers; experienced technicians; hardwired high-pressure shutdowns
treatment_plan: Extend the CAB to field controllers; repository for all controllers; quarterly compare of running logic to baseline

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects a royalty owner, partner, or vendor payment to an attacker's bank account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High volume of payee bank changes (about 14,000 owners); land and accounting staff targeted
existing_controls: MFA; dual approval of payment runs; call-back verification for bank changes; external email tagging
treatment_plan: Payment fraud drills twice a year; bank change cooling-off period of 5 business days; monthly report of bank changes to the CFO

threat_event: Former employee or contractor uses a SCADA local account or controller password that was not removed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SCADA local accounts at the field offices and BCC removed manually; 4 of 25 sampled leavers still active (P07); area controller passwords changed annually
existing_controls: Automatic identity provider disablement; badge removal
treatment_plan: Termination checklist item for SCADA local accounts; quarterly reviews; change controller passwords when a holder leaves

threat_event: Intrusion into the SCADA network at South Florida, Alabama, or the BCC goes undetected, or an OT alert waits until the next business day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT sensors only at the OCC and Central Facility; OT alerts excluded from the MDR contract
existing_controls: OT sensors at the OCC and Panhandle; 24x7 MDR for IT
treatment_plan: Sensors at the South Florida office, BCC, and Alabama aggregation points; add OT alerts to the MDR contract with an OT runbook
exposure_estimate_usd: $500K-$3M (dwell time increases ransomware and safety impact)

threat_event: A known-exploited vulnerability in field device or modem firmware stays unpatched because the device is not in the inventory
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT inventory about 70% complete; South Florida and Alabama devices in partial spreadsheets
existing_controls: Inventory complete for the Panhandle and gathering system; CISA ICS advisory subscription
treatment_plan: Complete the inventory from sensor discovery and a site survey; match advisories monthly

threat_event: Attacker within radio range sends spoofed commands to RTUs over the licensed radio network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy radio protocol and about 140 older RTUs without message authentication
existing_controls: Licensed spectrum; hardwired safety shutdowns; OT sensor sees Panhandle radio traffic
treatment_plan: Accept until the 2028 radio refresh; require authenticated radios and RTUs in the refresh specification

threat_event: Hurricane, fire, or flood takes out the OCC and the BCC failover does not work
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: BCC full failover never tested (last partial test 2023); BCC standby server unsupported
existing_controls: BCC with standby server and HMIs; generators
treatment_plan: Full BCC failover test before hurricane season and twice a year after; written failover procedure

threat_event: Hurricane causes multi-day loss of power and communications to field sites
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Field sites on utility power; towers and cellular sites exposed
existing_controls: Pre-storm shut-in procedure in the emergency response plan
treatment_plan: Accept; the pre-storm shut-in procedure controls the safety and environmental impact

threat_event: Cellular carrier outage cuts off view of the 180 cellular sites
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single carrier for South Florida and remote sites
existing_controls: Manual route coverage
treatment_plan: Dual-carrier modems at the 40 highest-rate sites at the 2027 modem refresh

threat_event: Production accounting SaaS outage at month-end delays royalty payments and partner billings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS provider
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 commitments (RTO 24 h, RPO 1 h); monthly encrypted owner deck export
treatment_plan: Accept; within appetite because the vendor's commitments meet the BIA

threat_event: Breach at the production accounting vendor exposes royalty owner personal information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor holds Social Security numbers and bank data for about 14,000 owners
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(6); breach laws of each state where affected individuals reside
existing_controls: Annual SOC 2 review; contract requires notice within 5 business days
treatment_plan: Keep the 5-business-day notice term; confirm the vendor's cyber insurance; cyber policy covers notification costs

threat_event: Compromised SCADA software update or integrator laptop introduces malware into the SCADA network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrator laptops connect at field offices without checks; update hashes verified only at the OCC
existing_controls: Integrator security schedule (2025); jump host for remote work; hash checks at the OCC
treatment_plan: Scanning kiosks at the South Florida office and BCC; company-issued maintenance laptops for integrator site work

threat_event: OT vendors with weak security (compressor packager, flow computer vendor, SCADA integrator) become the entry point to SCADA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT vendors never assessed; packager and flow computer contracts lack security terms
existing_controls: Integrator security schedule; jump host for the integrator
treatment_plan: Assess the 3 critical OT vendors; security schedule at renewal; vendor tiering (STD-03)

threat_event: A shipper disputes measurement or claims damages after an incident because the gathering agreements have no data handling or incident notice terms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gathering agreements silent on security, confidentiality controls, and incident notice
existing_controls: General confidentiality clause
treatment_plan: Data handling and incident notice amendment for all 5 agreements; SOC 2 Type 2 report (P09)
exposure_estimate_usd: $200K-$1M (fee credits, legal costs, loss of a shipper)

threat_event: A shipper sees another shipper's volumes through a portal access error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One administrator manages all shipper accounts; no access review
existing_controls: Row-level access by shipper; MFA
treatment_plan: Second administrator; quarterly access review with each shipper's contact

threat_event: Lost or stolen rugged tablet gives access to the field data capture app
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tablets left in unattended trucks at well pads
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-09 tablets; SYS-04 field data capture app
existing_controls: MDM with remote wipe; encryption; SSO with MFA
treatment_plan: Accept; existing controls reduce it to Low

threat_event: Infected USB drive or technician laptop spreads malware to South Florida or BCC HMIs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: USB storage allowed on South Florida and BCC HMIs; no scanning kiosk there
existing_controls: USB blocked and kiosk at the OCC
treatment_plan: Block USB storage on all HMIs; kiosks at the South Florida office and BCC

threat_event: Insider falsifies run tickets or LACT tickets to hide theft of crude
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Ticket edits recorded (2026) but not reviewed; no reconciliation of truck tickets to SCADA tank levels in Alabama
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 field data capture app; SYS-14; BP-05; BP-06
existing_controls: Tickets lock after submission; purchaser gauger co-signs
treatment_plan: Monthly reconciliation of tickets to tank levels in all areas; review of edited tickets

threat_event: Tampering with an RTU cabinet at an unmanned well pad
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote pads with padlocked cabinets; no door alarms; gate combinations changed annually
existing_controls: Fenced and locked pads; lease operator visits
treatment_plan: Accept; add cabinet door switches to SCADA alarms when cabinets are replaced

threat_event: Stolen cloud administrator credential used to encrypt or delete cloud workloads
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Cloud administration concentrated in a small team
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA; privileged access broker with just-in-time elevation; delete-proof backups in a separate account
treatment_plan: Accept; existing controls are strong (P04 finding 3)

threat_event: A cyber event causes a release on the regulated trunk line and the 1-hour telephone notice is missed because responders treat it only as an IT incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Cyber runbooks were not linked to the pipeline emergency procedures until P08; Production Controllers not trained on cyber-caused abnormal operations
existing_controls: Pipeline emergency procedures; NRC contact sheets at the OCC
treatment_plan: Cross-reference the P08 runbooks and the pipeline emergency procedures; joint tabletop with the Pipeline Compliance Manager

threat_event: Uncoordinated response during a cyber incident: the crisis management team has never met, fields are shut in unnecessarily, or SCADA stays connected too long
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT annex and crisis management team never exercised; South Florida and Alabama teams untrained
existing_controls: IT tabletop yearly; MDR runbooks
treatment_plan: Crisis management tabletop with the CEO and General Counsel; OT tabletops in each area

threat_event: Employee personal information or vehicle location history exposed by the HR or telematics vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendors hold Social Security numbers and geolocation for 850 employees
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(6); breach laws of each state where affected individuals reside
existing_controls: HR vendor SOC 2 reviewed; telematics vendor has security terms
treatment_plan: Obtain the telematics vendor's SOC 2 report; add notice terms at renewal

threat_event: Predictive maintenance model (AI-001) misses pump failures or systematically under-serves South Florida ESP wells
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Trained mostly on Panhandle rod pumps; South Florida cellular sites send data every 15 minutes; bias testing not completed
existing_controls: Engineer reviews every alert
treatment_plan: Bias and performance testing by group (P10); South Florida in shadow mode until thresholds met

threat_event: Enterprise AI assistant surfaces confidential files to users who were over-shared access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy broad sharing in some departmental sites; AI assistant searches all files a user can open
existing_controls: Sharing restricted to the company; reservoir folders restricted
treatment_plan: Clean up broad sharing before expanding the assistant beyond 300 users; label Restricted folders

threat_event: Production Controllers over-rely on the leak analytics tool (AI-003) and dismiss a real leak alarm
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor model new in 2026; false alert rate high in the first months
existing_controls: Pressure and flow alarms and line riders remain primary; the tool is advisory
treatment_plan: Controller procedure: analytics never clear an alarm; monthly review of dismissed alerts; vendor performance reporting

threat_event: The HR candidate-screening feature (AI-004) is switched on and screens out applicants unfairly
threat_source: Vendor default setting or HR configuration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature licensed; no bias review or adverse impact testing
regulatory_driver: Title VII of the Civil Rights Act (42 U.S.C. 2000e-2) and similar employment laws
existing_controls: Feature switched off; HR Director controls settings
treatment_plan: Keep the feature off until an AI review (P10) and an adverse impact test are complete

threat_event: Only one or two people can rebuild the SCADA configuration and run the OT security tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SCADA and Automation Manager and OT Security Engineer hold most of the knowledge; documentation incomplete
existing_controls: Integrator support contract
treatment_plan: Document build and restore steps; cross-train 2 automation supervisors; integrator retainer for OT security support

threat_event: Cyber insurance claim is disputed because vendor remote access lacked the MFA the policy requires
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Packager gateways and the flow computer vendor modem have no MFA
existing_controls: MFA on all company-user remote access and the jump host
treatment_plan: Close R-004 and R-052; confirm remediation to the carrier in writing before the 2027 renewal
exposure_estimate_usd: Up to $15M of coverage at risk

threat_event: Royalty owner Social Security numbers in the data platform copy are viewed or taken by any of 34 engineers or an attacker using an engineer's account
threat_source: Workforce member or attacker with an engineer's credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Full owner deck copy with Social Security numbers readable by all engineers
existing_controls: Access logging; MFA
treatment_plan: Replace the copy with a de-identified extract; delete the full copy

threat_event: Owner tax files emailed to the outside tax vendor are intercepted or misdirected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Password-protected attachments by email
existing_controls: Password-protected attachments; passwords sent by phone
treatment_plan: Deliver files through the production accounting vendor's secure transfer

threat_event: Departing geoscientist or engineer copies seismic interpretations and reservoir models
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bulk download alerts only in the data platform; productivity suite sharing broader
existing_controls: Restricted reservoir folders; bulk download alerts in the data platform
treatment_plan: Extend download alerts to the productivity suite; exit checklist with access review

threat_event: Stolen engineer credentials used on OT engineering workstations, which are outside privileged access management
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT engineering workstations and SCADA administrator accounts not in the PAM vault
existing_controls: Engineering workstations only in the OCC; badge access
treatment_plan: Bring SCADA administrator accounts into the PAM vault; MFA at the OT directory for engineering roles

threat_event: A harmful command from a South Florida or BCC HMI cannot be traced to a person because of the shared engineering account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared engineering account on South Florida and BCC HMIs
existing_controls: Badge access to the rooms
treatment_plan: Named accounts from the OT directory; shift sign-in log as the interim compensating control

threat_event: Phishing of field staff on company smartphones leads to account takeover
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 30% of field crews and drivers not yet briefed; smartphones receive email
existing_controls: MFA with number matching; MDM
treatment_plan: Complete the field briefing; text-message phishing examples in safety meetings

threat_event: Identity provider outage blocks access to SaaS applications and the jump host
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single identity provider
existing_controls: Break-glass accounts; SCADA HMIs at the OCC do not depend on the identity provider
treatment_plan: Accept; SCADA operations continue without it

threat_event: Denial-of-service attack or outage makes the shipper portal unavailable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internet-facing portal
existing_controls: Provider web front door with denial-of-service protection; statements by email as fallback
treatment_plan: Accept; the fallback meets the BIA

threat_event: Clock drift at field controllers and flow computers undermines incident timelines and accident report data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Field devices not synchronized to a time source
existing_controls: OCC systems synchronized
treatment_plan: Time synchronization through the SCADA polling at the next RTU configuration cycle

threat_event: SCADA historian event journal and HMI logs roll over after 30 days, so an investigation lacks evidence
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 30-day local retention; not sent to the SIEM
existing_controls: OCC jump host logs in the SIEM
treatment_plan: Forward SCADA event journals to the SIEM with 1-year retention

threat_event: Retired RTUs, HMIs, or flow computers are scrapped with configurations and passwords intact
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Field crews scrap devices without wiping
existing_controls: None for OT devices
treatment_plan: Wipe procedure and certificate for OT devices; collect retired devices at the warehouse

threat_event: An acquired field is connected to company networks with unknown OT and accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PE growth plan targets bolt-on acquisitions; no OT due diligence checklist
existing_controls: IT due diligence questionnaire
treatment_plan: OT due diligence checklist; connect acquired fields only through a separate firewall until assessed

threat_event: A TSA notification, a CIRCIA final rule, or growth past 1,250 employees changes the company's obligations without preparation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No routine tracking of designation and rule status before 2026
existing_controls: Quarterly regulatory watch since 2026 (P03)
treatment_plan: General Counsel and Security Manager review rule status each quarter

threat_event: Trespass or vandalism at the gathering pump station or Central Facility
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rural site; cameras but no after-hours monitoring
existing_controls: Fencing; cameras; gate alarms to the OCC
treatment_plan: Accept; gate alarms already reach the OCC

threat_event: An integration error publishes wrong daily volumes on the shipper portal, and shippers nominate on bad data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Portal statements are not reconciled to LACT tickets before publishing
existing_controls: Monthly reconciliation at invoicing
treatment_plan: Daily automated reconciliation before publishing; change control for portal releases

threat_event: Internet scan finds compression station packager gateways with a shared password and reaches a station PLC (found in P07 testing)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 of 4 packager gateways accept inbound internet connections with the packager's shared password; 1 reaches the station PLC
existing_controls: Hardwired compressor emergency shutdowns
treatment_plan: Block inbound internet access on all 4 gateways immediately; move packager support to the jump host; change all passwords
